news.title: Bhubaneswar: 10 years on, allottees yet to get Dhauli Heights flats, announce mass dharna
news.para: The plight of hundreds of families waiting for their Dhauli Heights residences continues, now extending beyond ten years. These allottees have poured countless resources into what was promised but is yet to materialize. Even with assurances that fell flat and numerous talks, frustrations grow. Families are gearing up for a collective dharna, pressing for governmental action that establishes a clear deadline for possession.

news.title: Chandigarh gets room to grow as heritage panel clears master plan changes
news.para: The conditional approval for Chandigarh's Master Plan 2031 marks a significant step towards future development. This plan will introduce enhanced flexibility for housing and industrial sectors in subsequent phases, while keeping the existing framework intact for sectors one to thirty. Comprehensive infrastructure and traffic studies will inform the execution of these amendments, which are now set to be forwarded to the Ministry of Home Affairs.

news.title: Gurugram: 900 meter buffer zone earmarked, but not even nine meter gap between houses & IAF ammo depot
news.para: A concerning situation has arisen in Gurgaon, where illegal developments have spread throughout a restricted area surrounding an Air Force depot. The Supreme Court has criticized state officials for their alleged cooperation with land mafia, allowing these constructions to thrive despite the clear risks to national security. This ongoing issue reflects a long-standing failure by authorities to uphold laws safeguarding crucial defense installations from unchecked urban expansion.

news.title: NGT seeks demolition plan details from Ghaziabad development body of colony on park land
news.para: The National Green Tribunal has requested the Ghaziabad Development Authority to clarify its demolition plans regarding encroachments on park land due to a nearby colony and industrial installations. They are particularly focused on rehabilitation strategies for the displaced families. A progress report has been delivered to the tribunal, with a follow-up hearing scheduled for December tenth.

news.title: Allahabad HC orders survey of Gulmohar Greens after row over 112 extra flats, CC
news.para: The Allahabad High Court has tasked an advocate commissioner with examining the situation at Gulmohar Greens. This follows differing claims made by residents and the Ghaziabad Development Authority. The inspection takes place on September 19 and 20, with the court requesting a thorough report to address issues of construction and completion certificates by the hearing date of September 30.

news.title: Sanjay Nayar buys ₹90 crore luxury apartment in South Mumbai’s Carmichael Road
news.para: The transaction involves a 4,537.29 sq ft apartment on the first floor of Kamal Mahal, Anand Kamal Co-operative Housing Society Ltd, located on M L Dahanukar Marg, also known as Carmichael Road. The deal works out to around Rs 1.98 lakh per sq ft based on the carpet area.

news.title: Bombay HC sets guidelines for land title on layout with multiple buildings
news.para: The Bombay High Court has introduced fresh guidelines concerning land division in redevelopment initiatives. Upon formation, each society will gain a proportional land entitlement that is safeguarded against reductions from future plan adjustments. Moreover, builders are required to reveal any risks linked to transferable development rights. This decision seeks to address persistent conflicts surrounding land conveyance issues.

news.title: Rentomojo shares jump over 32% in debut trade
news.para: Rentomojo Ltd's shares made a remarkable entry, surging over thirty-two percent by the close of trading. The online rental giant's stock witnessed a robust listing premium across both exchanges. Investors showed overwhelming interest, with the initial public offering being significantly oversubscribed just last week. The company successfully garnered substantial funds through its fresh issue and offer for sale, continuing to expand its technology-driven rental platform.

news.title: HC extends interim direction restraining allotments in Oberoi Realty's project in Gurugram till September 25
news.para: The Punjab and Haryana High Court has decided to prolong its interim order, which halts any new allotments, particularly impacting the Oberoi 360 North luxury housing project in Gurugram. The decision followed a petition from Advance India Projects Ltd challenging the director of DTCP's directive from August 17, claiming non-alignment with prior decisions. Further proceedings are set to take place on September 25.

news.title: ED raids ex-Haryana minister Gopal Kanda in PMLA case linked to real estate 'fraud'
news.para: The Enforcement Directorate launched a series of raids at properties linked to former Haryana minister Gopal Kanda, as part of a broader investigation into money laundering tied to real estate fraud. This inquiry focuses on a company that allegedly misled investors and diverted their funds. Kanda’s assets are now under scrutiny, following an earlier raid by the ED in August 2023.

news.title: NCLAT rejects Noida & Greater Noida authorities' plea for secured creditor status in Shubhkamna Buildtech case
news.para: The NCLAT has rejected the claims of Noida and Greater Noida authorities as secured creditors. The 2026 IBC amendment has clarified that only agreements can create security interests, leaving statutory charges out of the equation. Consequently, homebuyers are relieved from any further payments under the approved resolution plan, with the tribunal maintaining the unsecured creditor status of the authorities.

news.title: Struggling US home buyers, and market, face new hurdles as mortgage rates near 7%
news.para: As mortgage rates approach seven percent, homebuyers are encountering serious obstacles in the housing market. This increase in borrowing costs diminishes many people's purchasing power. Additionally, the latest Federal Reserve interest rate hike is contributing to the upward trend in these rates, suggesting a continued slowdown in the housing market. Consequently, affordability will likely hinder prospective buyers from entering the market anytime soon.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh RERA shifts QPR professional certificates to digital filing
news.para: Uttar Pradesh RERA has detailed the process for digital submission of architect, engineer and chartered accountant certificates along with quarterly progress reports. The move is part of the transition to the UP RERA 2.0 portal.

news.title: DGS Group strengthens its footprint in Andheri Lokhandwala with major redevelopment portfolio
news.para: DGS Group is actively broadening its redevelopment efforts in Andheri Lokhandwala, pledging around twenty lakh sq. ft. to various projects. The company is engaged in several high-profile joint redevelopment schemes in this iconic Mumbai locale, striving to convert older buildings into contemporary residential and commercial spaces. This ambitious expansion is guided by the strategic vision of Brahmdev Shukla.

news.title: Ganpati Group plans to invest ₹2,000 crore to develop projects in Lucknow & Visakhapatnam
news.para: Ganpati Group has outlined an investment and development pipeline of about ₹2,000 crore across residential and hospitality projects in Lucknow and Visakhapatnam. The company plans an ultra-luxury housing project and a 200-key hotel in Lucknow, along with a 100-room business hotel in Visakhapatnam.

news.title: Puravankara to redevelop three projects in Mumbai; Paradigm Realty to invest ₹80 crore to redevelop Bandra project
news.para: Puravankara has obtained redevelopment rights for three societies in Mumbai, unlocking a substantial development opportunity. Additionally, Paradigm Realty is set to invest Rs 80 crore to transform a residential building in Bandra, with an anticipated gross development value of Rs 350 crore. Collectively, these projects represent a potential of around $125 million, with both companies gearing up for forthcoming launches and the initiation of these redevelopment ventures.

news.title: Enforcement directorate arrests Kolkata-based builder for land grab, illegal constructions
news.para: Enforcement Directorate apprehends real estate developer Amit Gangopadhyay amid serious allegations of land occupation and illegal construction activities. His company reportedly used falsified documentation to illegally acquire plots of land. With numerous FIRs filed against him over the past year, Gangopadhyay was presented in court and remanded to police custody for ongoing investigations.

news.title: Only 15 of 2,013 Haryana construction & demolition sites have functional cameras, CAQM finds
news.para: A recent oversight revealed that few construction sites in Haryana had functioning web cameras, raising concerns during a monitoring exercise. The Commission for Air Quality Management identified major compliance failures by the pollution control board. This oversight compromises the remote monitoring portal's effectiveness. Authorities have been ordered to enforce strict compliance, with the potential for closure of sites that do not adhere to regulations as enforcement measures are ramped up.

news.title: Ahmedabad: New rules propose FIRs for unauthorised demolitions
news.para: Ahmedabad's town development department has drafted a new demolition policy for sustainable redevelopment. This policy aims to ensure citizen safety and environmental protection during property demolitions. Property owners and contractors will face penalties and police complaints for flouting regulations. Structures exceeding specific sizes will require detailed assessment and management plans. Strict compliance with safety and environmental rules is mandatory for all demolition activities.

news.title: Chandigarh housing board clears need-based changes in houses, lifts in all dwelling units
news.para: The Chandigarh Housing Board has greenlit essential adjustments for independent homes, allowing lifts in all CHB residences without needing consent from every resident. Additionally, the installation of solar panels can proceed without CHB authorization under a government initiative. These innovative measures are designed to meet persistent requests from residents and enhance overall housing amenities.
